nvitk.morphology.binary¶

Binary (and gray) morphological operators: dilate, erode, open, close, fill_holes.

Functions¶

dilate(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Morphological dilation.

erode(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Morphological erosion (counterpart to dilate()).

open(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Morphological opening = erode followed by dilate.

close(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Morphological closing = dilate followed by erode.

fill_holes(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Fill holes in a binary mask.

Module Contents¶

nvitk.morphology.binary.dilate(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any, footprint: int | Any | None = None, *, iterations: int = 1, mode: str = 'binary', isotropic: bool = False, spacing: Sequence[float] | None = None, connectivity: int = 2) → nvitk.types.Image | Any¶

Morphological dilation.

Parameters:

  • img – Input mask (Image or array).

  • footprint – Structuring element. None → unit ball; int → iterated unit ball of that radius; array → used as-is (cast to the active backend).

  • iterations – Passed to ndi.binary_dilation (integer ≥ 1).

  • mode – "binary" or "gray".

  • isotropic – When footprint is int and isotropic=True, resample the ball to isotropic voxels using spacing.

  • spacing – When footprint is int and isotropic=True, resample the ball to isotropic voxels using spacing.

  • connectivity – Base connectivity for the unit structure (1 = face, 2 = edge, …).

Morphological erosion (counterpart to dilate()).

nvitk.morphology.binary.fill_holes(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, axis: int | None = None, structure: Any | None = None, mode: str = 'binary') → nvitk.types.Image | Any¶

Fill holes in a binary mask.

Parameters:

  • img – Input binary mask.

  • axis – If provided, apply slicewise along axis (useful for axial fills that should not close inter-slice voids). If None, fill in 3D.

  • structure – See scipy.ndimage.binary_fill_holes.

  • mode – See scipy.ndimage.binary_fill_holes.
